lines.en: Sometimes you may wonder if some people
lines.ko: 가끔 이런 생각이 들 수도 있어요. 어떤 사람들은

lines.en: just aren't better at certain things.
lines.ko: 그냥 어떤 걸 더 잘하는 게 아닐까.

lines.en: You know, well, I'm not good at math,
or I'm just not really interested in my science classes.
But just because you're not the best at something today
lines.ko: 하지만 오늘 어떤 걸 제일 잘하지 못한다고 해서

lines.en: doesn't mean you can't be tomorrow.
Even if you don't think of yourself as a math person or a science person,
lines.ko: 스스로 수학이나 과학 체질이 아니라고 생각해도

lines.en: you can still excel in those subjects
lines.ko: 그 과목들을 얼마든지 잘할 수 있습니다.

lines.en: if you're willing to make the effort.
And you may find out you have talents you never dreamed of.
lines.ko: 꿈에도 몰랐던 재능을 발견할 수도 있고요.

lines.en: Because one of the things I've discovered is excelling,
lines.ko: 제가 깨달은 게 있는데, 뛰어나다는 건

lines.en: whether it's in school or in life,
isn't mainly about being [smarter than everybody else].
That's not really the secret to success.
It's about [working harder] than everybody else.
Don't give up if you don't succeed at something the first time.
[Try again], and learn from your mistakes.
